snippet.description:
eFootball 2027 has introduced a brand-new Team Playstyle: OVERLOAD! 🔥
In this video, I break down Frank Lampard’s Overload Team Playstyle and explain exactly how it works when attacking, defending, after winning possession, and after losing the ball.

Overload is built around creating numerical superiority around the ball, using short passes to break through the opposition, while also shifting the entire team toward the ball when defending.

⚽ How Overload Works

ATTACKING:
Players move closer to the ball to create numerical superiority in a small area, allowing you to use quick short passes to break through the defence.

DEFENDING:
The entire team shifts toward the side of the pitch where the ball is located, creating a compact defensive shape. When the ball is high up the pitch, the team can press aggressively.

AFTER GAINING POSSESSION:
Nearby players immediately provide support, with possession retention prioritized. If you win the ball high up the pitch or play a forward pass immediately after winning possession, the team can launch a counterattack.

AFTER LOSING POSSESSION:
Nearby players aggressively press the opponent in numbers, attempting to win the ball back quickly.

In this eFootball 2027 Overload tutorial/review, I’ll test Frank Lampard’s new Team Playstyle in real gameplay to see whether this possession-based, compact pressing system is actually effective.
